February 7-13 | Natural Disasters Summary 

February 7
Italy | Liguria - Severe thunderstorm with large hail hit Rapallo and Savona, highways turned into icy rivers, multiple crashes on A12, several injured.
Syria | Jisr al-Shughur - Heavy rain caused flooding, around 30 families affected.
Brazil | Ribeirão Preto - 42 mm of rain triggered urban flooding and damage.
South Korea | Gyeongju - Forest fire burned about 10 hectares, over 100 residents evacuated.

February 8
Spain | Andalusia - Storm Marta caused major flooding, over 11,000 evacuated, 180 roads closed, 2 fatalities confirmed.
Indonesia | Balikpapan - Building collapsed during heavy rain and squalls, 1 person killed.
Morocco | Northern regions - Massive flooding continues, over 154,000 evacuated, 4 confirmed deaths.
China | Kunming - Intense hailstorm covered streets and caused traffic disruption.

February 9
Brazil | Rio de Janeiro - Torrential rain caused flooding and landslides, 2 people electrocuted by a downed power line.
Philippines | Albay Province - Mayon Volcano produced major pyroclastic flow and ashfall, Alert Level 3 remains in effect.
South Africa | Eastern Cape - Severe thunderstorm with hail damaged homes and businesses.
Greece | Vrondados, Chios - Sudden hailstorm destroyed citrus crops and flooded streets.
Indonesia | Probolinggo Regency - River overflow flooded homes, 27 households affected.

February 10
Portugal | Coimbra - Rivers overflowed, homes flooded, evacuations underway.
Russia | Krasnodar Krai - 4.8 magnitude earthquake, no damage reported.
Madagascar | Toamasina - Cyclone Gezani struck with winds up to 250 km/h, 9 dead, nearly 2,000 evacuated.

February 11
Colombia | Bogotá - Heavy rain and hail caused severe flooding and traffic paralysis, nationwide toll since January 26 reached 44 deaths.
Madagascar | Nationwide - Cyclone Gezani death toll rose to 31, over 250,000 homes damaged.
Brazil | Rio de Janeiro State - Intense rainfall flooded Rocinha and hillside areas, high landslide risk.
Syria | Idlib Province - Cyclone conditions with heavy rain and hail, 173 families evacuated from camps.

February 12
Indonesia | West Java - Widespread flooding and landslides, over 140 homes damaged in Bogor region.
Tunisia | Nationwide - Wind gusts exceeded 100 km/h, power outages reported.
Chile | Coquimbo Region - 6.6 magnitude earthquake caused light to moderate damage.
Italy | Sardinia - Mediterranean cyclone brought 100 km/h winds and 7-9 m waves, coastal damage reported.

February 13
Italy | Calabria - Mediterranean cyclone brought 250 mm of rain in 48 hours.
France | Réunion Island - Piton de la Fournaise began an effusive eruption.
Paraguay | Fernando de la Mora - Torrential rain caused flash flooding.
Turkey | Kahramanmaraş - Rivers overflowed after heavy rain.
Indonesia | East Java - Semeru volcano erupted multiple times.
